title: Mother Holding Barefoot Baby, Porch Yard - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful Depression-era snapshot dated July 14, 1932, showing a smiling young woman holding an alert, barefoot baby in her arms. The woman features a chic early 1930s bobbed hairstyle and wears a patterned diagonal-striped summer dress with a narrow belt and buckle-strap shoes. They are positioned outdoors on the grass beside garden plants in front of the wooden railing of a home's front porch.
